patch.value: GH-1781: secret guard reports a single-quoted reference in compact JSON, and a value of seven backslashes, as password_assignment on 2026.11.25

Follow-up to GH-1775 (fixed in 2026.11.25). Two neighbouring shapes that returned no finding on 2026.11.14 are reported as password_assignment on 2026.11.25. First, a single-quoted run-time reference inside a JSON string in compact form: title 'password': '${BUILD_PASSWORD}' followed directly by the next member; pretty JSON, a title-only object and the double-quoted twin stay clean, so the verdict depends on serialization. Second, a single-quoted value made only of backslashes: seven backslashes (an unterminated value, since the last quote is escaped) is reported where 2026.11.14 reported nothing; six stay clean and eight were already reported. Reading: the single-quoted value is not ended at its own closing quote when it sits inside a JSON string, and an escape-only value is judged as a literal secret.

The four JSON forms of the single-quoted reference return no findings; Single-quoted values of six and seven backslashes return no findings; a literal password is still reported; A differential against the published 2026.11.14 bundle shows no other verdict change for the reported shapes
A pure run-time reference in a single-quoted value is clean in every JSON serialization, and an escape-only value carries no secret finding, as on 2026.11.14
Compact JSON with a single-quoted reference and a seven-backslash single-quoted value report password_assignment

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Root cause, from a tsx trace of the structured pass: (1) compact JSON: the quoted key 'password' inside the title string is judged by findStructuredSpellingMatches, whose value judge reads the concatenating PASSWORD_VALUE grammar without the enclosing-string close that GH-1775 added to flatMatches, so '${BUILD_PASSWORD}' runs on through the JSON string's closing quote into ","updated":"2026-11-25T00 (pretty JSON hides it because a quoted piece cannot cross the newline). (2) seven backslashes: the single-quoted raw (TOML/YAML) reading reused the escape-aware scanQuoted span, in which the seventh backslash escapes the final quote, so the literal read as unterminated and the quote counted as an eighth data character. Fix: the structured judge ends a text-read value at the enclosing string's close exactly as flatMatches does (cut, and recorded as the word end), through a lexer cursor with checkpoints every 1024 code units for keys nested in already-walked containers; the raw single-quoted reading ends at its own first quote. Differential over an 18,816-input corpus (8 keys x 26 values x quote styles x 7 serializations) against the published 2026.11.14 and 2026.11.25 bundles: 280 verdicts change, every one a finding to none, none on a literal-bearing value; 240 return to the 2026.11.14 verdict and the other 40 are bare $NAME and %NAME% references in quoted-key text, now placeholders as GH-1775 states for every serialization. '${BUILD_PASSWORD}(note)' was clean on both published versions (the parenthesis ends the word); attached literals such as '${BUILD_PASSWORD}<literal>' stay reported.

value.note: structured value judge ends at the enclosing string; raw single-quoted reading ends at its first quote
